trial_court: Family Court, Dhamtari, District- Dhamtari (C.G.) - Civil Suit No. 45-A/2019
case_name: Smt. Durgeshnandani Chandrakar vs Anurag Chandrakar
facts_of_case: Marriage of Durgeshnandani Chandrakar with Anurag Chandrakar in 2010; birth of child in 2011; respondent's family harassment and cruelty against petitioner; petition for divorce filed by respondent; petitioner seeks transfer of civil suit to Family Court, Mahasamund.

legal_principles.principle: The convenience of the wife is a relevant factor in determining the transfer of proceedings.
legal_principles.held: It is settled position of law that the convenience of wife is relevant factor over the convenience of the husband.
cited_cases: Rajani Kishore Pardeshi Vs. Kishor Babulal Pardeshi, (2005) 12 SCC 237
Bhartiben Ravibhai Rav Vs. Ravibhai Govindbhai Rav, (2017) 6 SCC 785

legal_principles.principle: The burden lies on the party seeking transfer to show that it is inconvenient for them.
legal_principles.held: None mentioned in this judgment, but implied from the discussion.
use_in: all types of cases where transfer is sought

outcome.final_order: The Civil Suit No. 45-A/2019 pending before the Family Court, Dhamtari, District- Dhamtari (C.G.) be transferred to Family Court, Mahasamund, District- Mahasamund (C.G.) for hearing and disposal in accordance with law.
